book.title: Nyovara Wao Jirum Petrus Po Ratoe 2 PETRUS

content: Petrus po kove raura

Risyirati Simon Petrus, syanapatambe Yesus Kristus ai, muno risyamo Kristus po inatutir indamu syo Apa Ayao Kove raura. Syo nyovara waowe so ratoe more vatan tenambe wapanave Yesus Kristus aije wasai. Kristus opirati wama Amisye pije muno Opirati po wansapaya wama ayao kakaije rai. Opamo apa ana dave mamai dave, weti wapa anave Po raugaje wasai omamo ramuinyo reama anave raije ramu, yara mamai kava.
Syare Amisye apa kove muno Apa saumane ntairi wasai, weye wapo Injayo Amisye aen muno wapo wama Amisy Yesus aen tavon.
Ananyao raugaje vatano Amisye po mawain po matayao mansai indamu utavondi Ai mavabe

Amisye apa vambunine mamo Po raugaje manakoeve wansai, indamu wambambunin wantavondi Apa bekere rai no mine so. Po apa vambunine raugaje wansai weye wamo aen to, Napi po wansawain mamaisyo taune Apa kovo ntiti muno anuga ngkove rarijati.

Maisyare wemaisy, Po apa urairijo ngko dave muno manakoe raugaje wansai. Po apa urairije umaso raugaje wansai indamu mo wansapaya irati mine so ama bekero ngkakainoanive rai, wemi mo kakaije raugavo vatane mai. Muno Po apa urairije umaso raugaje wansai indamu wansanuga indati mo taune anuga ramaisy.

Maisyare wemaisy, sya arakove, wabeke dave indamu wapo kovo syo ratodije so raugasya ntuna wasanuga rai no taiso: Wapanave Kristus ai to, weti umba syare wapa ana wadave ngkov bintabo indamu mo wapa anave ramaisy. Umbawe syare wapo Amisye apa bekere raen tenambe.
Umbawe syare wapo taune wapa ana wadaura muno wapa ana wadave raeranande indamu vemo wapo ayao kakaije rave nora. Umbawe syare wasatawandi tutir muno watavondi Amisye apa bekere rai mavabe.
Umbawe syare wabekobe irati wapa arakove mansai, muno wamuiny irati vatan tenambe mansai.
Syare kovo ratodi tenambe umawe mamo ntairi wasanuga rai muno miridi nseo. Vemo wapa wapo wama Amisy Yesus Kristus aene omamo mbea marudi nora, yara ama ine raen no wasai.

Weramu ranivara kovo ratodi umaso mamo meweno vatane inta ai, opamo maisyare amije ntuba ti apa ana po raene ngkaumudi. Weye vatano napije animari jirati apa ayao kakai wusyino Amisye po rapaya ai to rai.

Sya arakove, syare wabeke dave watavondi Amisy ai indamu wapo raen tugaive weapamo vatano Amisye po wasawain po wasatayao nawirati weap. Weti ranivara wapa ana wadave mamaisyo kovo ratodi umawe rai, wea indati wasakirive Amisye aije ramu.
Muno indati Amisye po unsanda rausiso wasai indamu wasisa munijo wama Amisy Yesus Kristus be akarivea ntoa nuge nuganui rai. Opirati po wansapaya wama ayao kakaije rai.
Weapamo wapo anakotare umawe raen to, muno watavondi ananyao tugae rai matuve to. Weramu syare syo raura nakato indamu wasaemen dai tutir.

Syo raen sya masyoto ikakai raije ndea mararai, maisyare wama Amisy Yesus Kristus po rarorono rinai to rai. Weti arono ritunana nene, syo anakotare umaso raura rijati akato indamu wasaemen dai, omamo mamaisy.
Weye ribeke dave syo unanuije rakani indamu arono indati rikakai to, weamo wasaemen irati sya ananyao syo raugaje wasai rai tutir.
Ayao anawae wusyine wo raurairive omamo mamai tugae

Ayao reamo raugaje wasai to omamo ayao umano mbe tugaive jewene ma jewena. Yara reamo raura tugaive arono reamo wasanyao reamare wama Amisy Yesus Kristus indati pakare akato no mine so, de irati Apa vambunine rautan. Reamo wasaponae ramu, weye reamirati reamo Apa vambunino kovo ntitije raeno taune reansamije rai to.

Weye masyoto wusyinoe reano Yesus arijat no unate inta rai arono Injayo Amisy po Yesus apa kovo ntiti raroron muno Po aura titive. Naije reandaniv anamote no no Amisyo Titi ngkinde mo Yesus aura mare, “Sopamo Sya Arikainyo inanuga no Ai rave. Inanayanambe Ai.” Reamirati reamo anamoto no no munijo ntiti umaso ranaun to.

Ana nande no unate umaso rai mbewar reamanave wamare ayao anawae wusyine omamo mamai tugae. Weti kove mamo wapo ayao anawae raraniv mavabe, weye awa ayao raurata irati yawainyo rakaindi ti mbaro namano kaumure rai. Ayao anawae mbar ava masyoto Yesus Kristus pakare ti taune Apa vare mbaro wasanuga rai, maisyare akane ntipu muno Tundinit seo no wanamuram ramaisy.
Arakove, syare wadanide, wapo ayao so ranaun kobe: Anawae wusyine wo Ayao Amisye ratoe mamaisyo taune awa bekere raije ramu.

Weye anawae awa ayao udaura mamo muje no taune mansai umba wo raura ramu. Yara Amisye apa Anawayo Vambunine mo vatane umaso mausuru tenambe muno Mo vambunine raugaje mai ti umba wo Amisye apa ayao raura.

footnotes.text: Aneme so ama ino kaijinta no taiso: Ayao Amisy wemi anawae wusyine wo ratoe mamo vemo vatane inta po rarijato taune apa bekere rai nora.
